_note: Locked baseline for the per-track policy work. If eval_refs stops reproducing these numbers, the code or the settings have drifted and nothing measured afterwards is comparable. Rename this folder to the real shot name.

settings.note: RunnerConfig defaults at the tag above, auto_tune on. Fill in any UI knob that was moved off its default for this run - without that this file cannot tell code drift from settings drift.

acceptance.phase1: mean_err AND first_step_loss must fall on every class row, not just the average.
acceptance.blocks: slow_ratio rising ABOVE its own baseline on any row means wobble was added; jerk_ratio rising above its baseline; first_step_loss flat means the seed-to-policy mapping is wrong.
acceptance.reading_the_baseline: fast 0.94 under-shoots fast motion and slow 1.22 over-shoots slow motion. Together that is the position being pulled toward where the point WAS instead of measured fresh (compare_tracks.py:17-19), and the 1.22 is the visible wobble. Per-track search radius and motion model target exactly this pair - fast should rise toward 1.00 and slow should FALL toward 1.00. Judge against these numbers, not against 1.00 as a pass mark.
